title: Home-Site Lease Agreement: Installments of a Repayment Agreement
content:
**Article — installments under a Home-Site Lease repayment agreement**

1. The balance left to spread is the lease balance once the down payment is received.
2. The plan runs the lot class's most installments as monthly installments due on the rent due day, starting the next month — one installment in each month of the plan.
3. Each installment is the balance left to spread divided by the number of installments, rounded half up to the cent; the last installment absorbs any rounding difference.

**Article restated**

| Item | Definition |
|---|---|
| Balance left to spread | the lease balance after the down payment is received on the signing date |
| Number of installments | the lot class's most installments, one per month |
| First installment due | the rent due day of the month after signing |
| Each installment | balance left to spread divided by the number of installments, rounded half up to the cent |
| Last installment | whatever remains after the earlier installments, absorbing the rounding difference |

**Worked figures (hypothetical: three installments, rent due on the 1st, signing on 12 May)**

| Balance left to spread | Division | Installments | Last installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1,125.00 | 1,125.00 divided by 3 | 375.00 due 1 June and 1 July | 375.00 due 1 August |
| 1,111.88 | 1,111.88 divided by 3 is 370.626…, rounded half up to 370.63 | 370.63 due 1 June and 1 July | 370.62 due 1 August, absorbing the rounding difference |

The balance left to spread is the whole lease balance after the down payment, read from the lease once the down payment has been received.
